# licensor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:licensor`](gmeow-licensor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/licensor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The party granting a licence ([odrl:assigner](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assigner)). A specialisation of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md). Non-functional: a licence may be granted jointly.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:licensor`](gmeow-licensor.md) from [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the party granting a licence (the [odrl:assigner](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assigner)) — the licence-scoped specialisation of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a separate granting-party model (this specialises [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md)) and avoid conflating the licensor with the copyright holder; a licensor may grant on a holder's behalf.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:licensor`](gmeow-licensor.md) agents to a [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) (non-functional for joint grants); pair with [`gmeow:licensee`](gmeow-licensee.md) for a named recipient, or omit the licensee for an open public offer.

### Examples

- ex:ccByLicense [`gmeow:licensor`](gmeow-licensor.md) ex:blackcat.
